column1: # Medical vocabulary pack, off by default. Kusema's own list, written for
# this project: common generic drug names and clinical terms. Names are
# facts; no drug database (RxNorm, the FDA's NDC directory or others) was
# copied, so no third-party license applies. Clinicians must review every
# dictated record: a vocabulary makes recognition better, not certain.
# Written form<TAB>sounds like|sounds like (lowercase; matched as whole words)
# A line without sounds-like forms is matched loosely (long, distinctive words only).
